fullDesc: The UNI-T LM50D is a professional laser distance meter that measures up to 50 m with millimetre accuracy, replacing the tape measure for construction, interior design, real-estate and site surveying. One button press gives an instant, repeatable reading on its large 2.4-inch colour backlit (EBTN) display — no ladders, no second person, no slack-tape error. Beyond straight distances it calculates area, volume, Pythagorean (indirect) height, triangle area, curvature and trapezoid , adds and subtracts measurements, and stores 20 readings. Built-in electronic levelling with on-screen angle plus audio/voice feedback make angled and one-handed measurements easy. Genuine UNI-T product supplied by Digilog.pk with warranty and English manual. Key Features 📏 Measures up to 50 m with accuracy ±(2 mm + 5×10⁻⁵·D) , resolution 1 mm 🧮 Area, volume & Pythagoras plus triangle-area, curvature, displacement & trapezoid modes ➕ Add / subtract measurements and store 20 groups of data 📐 Electronic levelling (horizontal & vertical) with on-screen angle for indirect height 🔆 2.4″ EBTN colour backlit display with audio/voice indication and line-laser marking 🔋 Class 2 laser (630–670 nm, <1 mW); runs on 2×AAA with auto power-off, laser-off & backlight-off Technical Specifications Measuring range 50 m Accuracy ±(2 mm + 5×10⁻⁵·D) Min. display unit 0.001 m Measurement units m / ft / in Measurement basis Front / middle / rear Measurement modes Single, continuous, max/min, area, volume, Pythagoras, triangle area, add/subtract, curvature, displacement, trapezoid Levelling Auto horizontal & vertical, electronic leveler Data storage 20 groups Display EBTN, 2.4-inch, backlit Laser class Class 2, 630–670 nm, <1 mW (red) Auto power-off 3 min (laser off 30 s, backlight 10 s) Operating temperature 0 °C – 40 °C Storage temperature -20 °C – 70 °C Power 2 × 1.5V AAA (LR03) Extras Audio/voice indication, battery-status display, line-laser marking What's in the Box LM50D laser distance meter Protective carrying pouch Hand strap 2 × AAA batteries English user manual Downloads UNI-T LM50D / LM100D Product Page Certifications: CE, RoHS | HS Code: 9015.10

fullDesc: The UNI-T UT261A is a professional 3-phase sequence indicator that instantly shows phase rotation (L1-L2-L3) and missing-phase faults on a large LCD — essential before connecting motors, pumps, compressors and any three-phase equipment where wrong rotation can cause damage. Connect the three colour-coded alligator clips to your supply and read the rotation direction and phase status directly, with a clear R (clockwise) / L (anti-clockwise) indication. It draws its power from the line under test, so no battery is required . Genuine UNI-T product supplied by Digilog.pk with warranty. fullDesc: The UNI-T UT258A is a precision AC/DC leakage current clamp meter built for measuring small leakage and load currents down to the milliamp — essential for insulation fault-finding, RCD/earth-leakage diagnosis and equipment safety testing. fullDesc: UNI-T UT8806E — The UNI-T UT8806EG is the GPIB variant of the UT8806E 6½-digit bench digital multimeter, with IEEE-488.2 GPIB substituting for the UT8806E's RS-232 port. All other specifications match the UT8806E: 0.0035% basic DC voltage accuracy, 10,000 rdgs/s maximum reading rate, 1,999,999-count display, True-RMS, four-wire resistance to 1 GΩ, dual display, and 32 Gb NAND Flash measurement storage. Genuine UNI-T product supplied by Digilog.pk with warranty. Key Features Interfaces — USB / LAN / RS-232 standard; GPIB is available on the UT8806EG variant. 6½-digit, 1,999,999-count display — 0.0035% basic DC voltage accuracy at the tier price point. True-RMS AC measurement — accurate readings on non-sinusoidal waveforms (switching supplies, motor drives, PWM, dimmed loads). Auto-ranging — across voltage, current, resistance, and capacitance functions, reducing operator workflow friction. 10,000 rdgs/s maximum reading rate — fast acquisition for high-throughput automated test and noise-reduction averaging.
